name: Build Your AI Video Factory — The Craft of AI-Assisted Storytelling

video_stack.hook: Faceless AI slop vs a video that means something — is the difference the tools, or the craft?
video_stack.recall: What does an AI video pipeline assemble?
video_stack.answer: script -> AI voice -> visuals/motion graphics -> captions -> music -> compositing -> render

tts_scripting.hook: A script that reads great on paper sounds robotic spoken. How do you write for the ear?
tts_scripting.recall: How do you script for AI voice (TTS)?
tts_scripting.answer: short sentences, natural phrasing, punctuation that cues pacing — write for listening

ai_voices.hook: No mic, no voice actor — yet a clear human narrator. What makes that?
ai_voices.recall: What does a TTS model (e.g. F5-TTS) give you?
ai_voices.answer: natural human-sounding narration from text, in multiple voices/languages

motion_graphics.hook: Talking over a static slide loses people. What makes the visuals move with the words?
motion_graphics.recall: What does a tool like Manim add?
motion_graphics.answer: precise animated motion graphics / diagrams synced to the narration

contextual_bg.hook: Why generate a background per scene instead of one stock loop?
contextual_bg.answer: visuals that match the words hold attention — generated per-scene from the script

kinetic_captions.hook: Most viewers watch muted. What keeps them following + boosts retention?
kinetic_captions.recall: What are word-synced kinetic captions, and why?
kinetic_captions.answer: captions that highlight word-by-word in time — retention + accessibility

music_beds.hook: Silence under narration feels flat; loud music buries it. What's the balance?
music_beds.recall: What's a music / focus-audio bed for?
music_beds.answer: a soft background track that sets emotion without competing with the voice

compositing.hook: Voice, visuals, captions, music — separate files. How do they become one video?
compositing.recall: What does compositing + GPU render do?
compositing.answer: layer all elements on one timeline and render the final MP4

localization.hook: One video, two languages, same visuals. How?
localization.recall: How do you make a bilingual/localized version?
localization.answer: re-narrate + re-caption in the other language over the same visuals

copyright_clean.hook: You want to monetize it without a takedown. What makes a video safe?
copyright_clean.answer: use license-safe assets + models so every video is safe to monetize
